extracted.intended_audience: researchers, academics, and policymakers studying agricultural cooperatives; readers of agricultural economics/cooperative studies
extracted.subtask_short: PRISMA systematic review of agricultural cooperatives
extracted.subtask_description: A PRISMA-based systematic review of studies on agricultural cooperatives that analyzes each selected study along defined dimensions and proposes a methodological framework to guide future research and comparative analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of PRISMA methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: The review is conducted using the PRISMA methodology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt PRISMA standards for systematic identification, screening, eligibility, and inclusion of studies to ensure transparent, reproducible review procedures. (Page text: '...using the PRISMA methodology.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Study analysis dimensions (purpose, methodology, factors examined, key findings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each selected study was analyzed based on four key dimensions: purpose, methodology, factors examined, and key findings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extract and record for every included study its stated purpose, the research methodology used, which factors the study examined, and its principal findings to enable structured comparison across studies. (Page text: 'Each selected study was analyzed based on four key dimensions: purpose, methodology, factors examined, and key findings.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Categorization of variables for comparative analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: The variables derived from the four dimensions are categorized to enable a more robust comparative analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Group similar purposes, methods, examined factors, and findings into categories or taxonomies so cross-study patterns and gaps become apparent; this categorization supports synthesis and the proposed methodological framework. (Page text: 'These variables were then categorized to enable a more robust comparative analysis.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of drivers of cooperative success
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognize and evaluate factors that drive the success of agricultural cooperatives, such as effective management, strong marketing strategies, a dedicated workforce, and education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When assessing or designing studies, include measures or indicators for management quality, marketing practices, workforce commitment, and education/training; treat these as key explanatory variables for performance comparisons. (Page text: 'The review highlights that the success of ACs is driven by effective management, strong marketing strategies, and a dedicated workforce. Education emerges as a critical factor...')

rubrics_metrics.name: Context-specificity of strategies and research
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledge that strategies for cooperative success differ among cooperatives and that context-specific research is required to accurately assess status and needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design studies and interpret results with attention to local/contextual differences (regional, institutional, cultural) rather than assuming uniform strategies; incorporate contextual variables and recommend context-sensitive policy or management implications. (Page text: 'However, strategies for success differ among cooperatives, underscoring the need for context-specific research to accurately assess the status and needs of ACs in various regions.')
